'''Lavik''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Rift Alliance Coalition Forces]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He served under the [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Felix Iresso]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and assisted the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the Jedi's [[Mission to Hoth (Barsen'thor)|mission]] to Hoth. After Iresso was permanently transferred over to the Jedi, Lavik was promoted to a specialist, which Iresso celebrated. Lavik was sent to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] for training.
